question.prompt: In uniform motion, $s=vt$. If the speed $v$ is fixed at 5 m/s while the time $t$ and distance $s$ change, how many variables are there in this process?

solutions.explanation: The value of $v$ does not change, so it is a constant. Both $t$ and $s$ take different values, so they are variables. There are 2 variables in total.
solutions.title: Count the changing quantities
